description_en: Creates a WINNEXO user in the current tenant and assigns roles and user groups to the user
description_zh: 在当前租户中创建WINNEXO用户，并为其分配角色和用户组
name: CreateUserWithGroups

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. This is a common parameter. In winnexo-cli, pass this parameter explicitly by using `--tenant-id`
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，公共参数；winnexo-cli 通过 `--tenant-id` 显式传入
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The WINNEXO logon account. This parameter is a unique identifier and cannot be empty
parameters.help_zh: WINNEXO 登录账号（唯一标识，不可为空）
parameters.name: wn_account_id

parameters.help_en: The display name of the user. The name must be unique within the tenant and cannot exceed 100 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用户显示名称（租户内唯一，最多100字）
parameters.name: display_name

parameters.help_en: The list of initial system role codes. If this parameter is not specified, the `APPLICATION_USER` role is assigned by default
parameters.help_zh: 初始系统角色 code 列表；不传默认 `APPLICATION_USER`
parameters.name: role_codes

parameters.help_en: The list of initial user group IDs. A maximum of 100 user group IDs can be specified. All user groups must belong to the current tenant
parameters.help_zh: 初始用户组 ID 列表，最多100个；所有用户组必须属于当前租户
parameters.name: user_group_ids

parameters.help_en: The Base64-encoded password ciphertext encrypted by using the RSA-OAEP-SHA256 algorithm
parameters.help_zh: RSA-OAEP-SHA256 加密后的 base64 密码密文
parameters.name: password_encrypted

200.description_en: 创建用户并设置初始角色和用户组
200.description_zh: 创建用户并设置初始角色和用户组

schema.description_en: The response for creating a user and setting initial roles and user groups
schema.description_zh: 创建用户并设置初始角色和用户组

displayName.description_en: The display name of the user

isNewUser.description_en: Indicates whether the user is newly created
